# Speedy Scholars

> Speedy Scholars provides live, one-to-one online abacus and mental arithmetic classes for children aged 4 to 14. All classes are taught by Nidhi Khariwal, who has over 20 years of teaching experience and has taught more than 2,000 students worldwide. The first 30-minute demo class is free.

Key facts:

- Service: live online abacus and mental math classes for children, taught over video
- Ages taught: 4 to 14, with 7 to 10 being the strongest starting window
- Instructor: Nidhi Khariwal, founder and lead instructor, 20+ years experience, 2,000+ students taught, 50+ competition winners coached
- Languages: English and Hindi
- Countries served: United States, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, India
- Class length: free demo is 30 minutes, regular classes are 45 minutes
- Pricing: single class $20 (£15, A$30, ₹1,600); 10-class pack $150 (£120, A$230, ₹12,500), which is $15 per class
- Fees: no joining fee, no registration fee, no exam fee, no long-term contract
- Format: live with an instructor, never pre-recorded, one-to-one or very small groups
- Booking: free 30-minute demo, no card details required
